# Charts with a KNOWN install/upgrade failure in a throwaway kind cluster. The
# install-test gate reports these as a warning instead of failing, so the gate can
# protect the other charts and all future changes. Remove a chart from this list
# once its issue is fixed — a clean chart must stay clean.
#
# The three entries below were found in shallow mode (manifests only). Now that the
# gate waits for pods to become Ready, expect charts that were never installed for
# real to surface genuine startup defects: the list is meant to absorb those as they
# are triaged, one line and one reason at a time. It is a queue of work, not a
# permanent exemption.
#
# Format: <chart> [class]   # reason
#   class `any` (default when omitted): every failure is absorbed — for a chart with
#   a real, triaged defect.
#   class `readiness`: only the install script's exit 2 is absorbed — every manifest
#   was accepted and applied, the workload never became Ready. A render, admission,
#   hook or upgrade error in that chart still fails the gate. For a chart that is
#   sound but needs a datastore kind does not run.
#
tracer readiness      # Needs a PostgreSQL the kind cluster does not run: the fixture's database host does not resolve, so the pod never becomes Ready.
reporter              # References external KEDA custom resources (keda.sh/v1alpha1: ScaledObject / ScaledJob / TriggerAuthentication) whose CRDs are not present in a bare kind cluster. Needs the KEDA CRDs pre-installed (a future enhancement) or the chart guarded behind a toggle.
otel-collector-lerian # DaemonSet renders a DUPLICATE env var GOMEMLIMIT — server-side apply rejects it ("duplicate entries for key GOMEMLIMIT"). Real chart bug: drop the duplicate (likely set in both the chart values and the opentelemetry-collector subchart).
plugin-br-pix-lerian  # 15-component Pix chart (spi/dict/cob/pixauto + systemplane adapters) needs real PostgreSQL, a broker and RSFN connectivity; migration/bootstrap hooks and readiness never complete against the fixture's postgres.example.invalid in a bare kind cluster. Manifests + admission are validated (helm template + --dry-run=server pass); full deploy is exercised via alpha + a real environment. Same class as reporter (external backing/CRDs).
plugin-br-pix-indirect-btg readiness # The API and the reconciliation worker exit at startup unless Midaz and plugin-crm answer /health, which kind does not run; an empty URL falls back to the chart default and the product has no mock mode.
plugin-br-sisbajud readiness # The image refuses to boot without a license the Lerian gateway accepts (kind has none), the executor needs a reachable Sisbajud Mensageria, and /readyz gates on an object-store probe the app wires in every mode (see the chart README). Render, admission and hooks still fail the gate.
br-sisbajud readiness # Chart now deploys the Sisbajud Mensageria (br-sfn services/sisbajud 1.0.0-beta.x). The fixture boots it on the full dev bundle (development: license dev bypass, generated execution TLS cert, throwaway JWT verification key), but no deep run has proven it Ready in kind yet (bundled Redpanda/OpenBao/SeaweedFS on one node). Remove once a deep run passes.
fetcher readiness # External-first chart: every bundled datastore subchart (mongodb/rabbitmq/valkey/seaweedfs) defaults off, and the worker hard-requires an external Kafka/Redpanda broker (STREAMING_BROKERS) this chart does not bundle. Manifests + admission pass (install applies, both pods schedule and pull images — the CI run reached CrashLoopBackOff, exit 2), but neither manager nor worker can reach Ready without external backing kind does not run. `readiness` class so a render/admission/hook regression still fails the gate; full deploy is exercised via alpha + a real environment.
agent                # The chart requires kubeVersion >=1.33 (the agent's supported window, held by the deployer fleet) and the gate's kind cluster runs v1.32, so the install is refused before any manifest; past that, the agent only becomes Ready once a Lerian control plane answers it, which kind does not run. Render and schema are validated by the chart standard gate.
plugin-fees readiness # With the CI license (HELM_CI_LICENSE_KEY_PLUGIN_FEES) the pod starts, but /readyz answers 503 and the liveness probe restarts it into CrashLoopBackOff (helm run 41222638064); the log shows only the OTel exporter failing to reach its collector. Find the dependency /readyz waits on, then remove this line.
midaz readiness # The baseline install from main never becomes Ready: the tracer component cannot resolve its Postgres host and the CRM component times out on its MongoDB ping in the fixture (red on midaz chart PRs since 2026-10-21, e.g. #2596). Triage the fixture or the chart defaults, then remove this line.
plugin-bc-correios readiness # With the CI license (HELM_CI_LICENSE_KEY_PLUGIN_BC_CORREIOS) the app starts, but the startup probe on /health/live answers 404 and the pod is restarted (helm run 41222638064): the chart probe path does not match the app. Point the probe at the endpoint the app serves, then remove this line.
plugin-br-payments readiness # The image pulls since the install values run it on the default ServiceAccount, then the app exits on "configuration validation failed" with the CI fixture; derive the missing values from that run and remove this line.
streaming-hub readiness # Needs PostgreSQL (STREAMING_HUB_POSTGRES_DSN is a boot-time requirement), a Kafka-compatible broker and a Lerian license (LICENSE_KEY, lib-license-go) to become Ready; a bare kind cluster has none of them and the chart bundles no subchart by design (external datastores through the lerian-common mask). Not a chart defect: remove once the install test can provision those dependencies.
plugin-br-ted-lerian readiness # The image now pulls (the install values clear the chart's ghcr-credential default), then the app exits on "CRM_CLIENT_ID is required when CRM_AUTH_ENABLED=true" with the CI fixture (helm run 41242701458). Add the CRM M2M credentials, and whatever the next run names, to the install values, then remove this line.
system-facts readiness # The app refuses to boot without a license the Lerian gateway accepts, and the repo has no HELM_CI_LICENSE_KEY_SYSTEM_FACTS yet; the fixture already carries the IT_LICENSE_KEY placeholder. Add that secret, then remove this line.
notifications readiness # Chart defaults leave both encryption keys and the PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ hosts empty, and the chart bundles none, so the pods never become Ready in kind. Not a chart defect.
